name: Maldives
intro: Escape to private overwater bungalows, turquoise lagoons, and white-sand bioluminescent beaches. The Maldives is the ultimate remote luxury sanctuary.
weather: Warm and tropical year-round. Average daytime temperature is 30°C. Brief monsoon rains occur from May to October.
visaInfo: Free 30-day visa on arrival issued to all nationalities.
flightDuration: Approx 4-5 hours from major Indian airports.
highlights: Stay in a luxury overwater villa with private lagoon slide
Snorkel or dive with whale sharks and giant manta rays
Enjoy private sandbank picnics isolated in the Indian Ocean
Dine in underwater glass restaurants surrounded by coral reefs
